Remove xizi_double_link_size wrapper, redundant explicit non-null precondition, public UINT_MAX bound, and unnecessary @pre. Preserve overflow proof internally via structural ownership reasoning.

forbidden_patterns: Do not retain xizi_double_link_size in the public contract; do not expose linklist != 0 or a UINT_MAX bound to callers; do not mirror the C algorithm in Rocq; do not read QCP_demos_human.
